findings.description: The tadpole probe is positive-only (empty output both when the tadpole did not age and when it is gone); since campaign51 showed a tadpole disappearing, a locked row with an empty post probe cannot alone distinguish denial from a missing tadpole. Denial is independently shown by ATD_CRITERION_SUPPRESSED, DENIAL_INTENT_DISCOVERED and no fountain_of_youth criterion.
No offhand_* rows for the map-into-item-frame and golden-dandelion cases although vanilla allows both from the off hand; the landmark guard is hand-independent, so this is a coverage gap only.
